chapter: First bands and the road in the South
title: Bands from New Orleans advertising dances on trucks
summary: Dance bands from New Orleans came to Mobile and played from trucks; the boy was allowed to play with them and learned the tunes.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Well, yes. Before I left home, the bands from New Orleans used to come over there and play dances. So they used to balley-hoo, and --
What do you mean? Come outside and --
Yeah. They used to be on a truck.
And go around and stop at different streets and play.
And sometimes I used to play with them.
Yeah. Sometimes they'd let me play with them.
Would they let you get up on the truck?
After they knew about me, they let me play with them.
So that way you began to get to know the numbers.
